name: zarchive_list_remove_payload
description: zArchiveList::RemovePayload finds a payload node, unlinks it from the circular archive list, frees the node, updates head/count, and returns the updated count or -1 on failure.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage exercises middle, head, tail/singleton, and absent-payload removal paths.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction and assembly for 0x48ca70 validate the null-list and empty-list -1 returns, FindNodeByPayload lookup, absent-payload -1 return, singleton head clear, non-singleton relink, head advance when removing the head node, FreeNode call, count decrement, and updated-count return.

The native smoke removes the middle payload from a three-node list, verifies head and next payload ordering, removes the head, removes the final singleton node, verifies the empty head field, and checks absent removal returns -1.
